Additionally, tech startups are exploring opportunities in areas such as AI chatbots, blockchain-based payment solutions, smart home automation services, health tech apps, virtual reality training platforms, and eco-friendly tech startups. However, entrepreneurs must navigate legal and compliance issues specific to each technology to avoid reputational damage and legal problems.
